maddeler.e:
أكتحل (form VIII)
# أَكْتَحِلُ (ʔaktaḥilu) /ʔak.ta.ħi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
# أَكْتَحِلَ (ʔaktaḥila) /ʔak.ta.ħi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
# أَكْتَحِلْ (ʔaktaḥil) /ʔak.ta.ħil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِكْتَحَلَ (iktaḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
